title: Florida House, District 3
what_it_does: Represents District 3 (Parts of Okaloosa, Santa Rosa) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Nathan Boyles
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Business owner (Adams Sanitation); former Okaloosa County commissioner; state representative (elected in a 2025 special election)
candidates.background: Boyles, a lawyer and engineer by training, founded a land-title company and grew Adams Sanitation into a 40-truck waste hauler. He served three terms on the Okaloosa County Commission and won a 2025 special election for HD 3.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

property_tax.summary: Voted for HJR 203 in February 2026 but was one of two House Republicans to vote against HJR 1F in June; he says property tax reform is timely but warned low-millage Panhandle counties would be forced to raise rates.
property_tax.quote: We have to be careful not to cut local funding mechanisms without having a plan to replace them.
